text:
Michael Amadio has scored in three straight games for Ottawa, the last of them the go-ahead goal with under three minutes left in Buffalo, a night the Ottawa Citizen's headline called a "BUFFALO BREAKTHROUGH." That gives the 30-year-old six goals and 10 points through 18 games in about 16 minutes a night. Last season he had 15 goals in 81 games.

Graeme Nichols of Coming Down the Pipe posted that Amadio "feels like he should have 10+ goals already this season." Our numbers lean the other way. His chances add up to 4.3 expected goals (the quality of his looks, measured in goals), and he is shooting 25% against a likely range closer to 15%. The goals are a little ahead of the process, not behind it.

What should last is the rest of his game. Evolving-Hockey had him worth 1.7 wins above replacement last season, with opponents getting fewer chances when he was out there (93rd percentile) and more penalties drawn than taken. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking found 57% of his shots come off the rush. Our range has him finishing with 13 to 24 goals; we'd lean toward the middle, around 18.
headline: Amadio's hot streak is real, the finishing less so
